free_tier.stated: Warp Free: "$0/month" with "Warp Agent CLI access", "Bring your own AI inference", "Limited cloud agents access", "Use any harness in the cloud (beta)", quoted; the billing FAQ says "Free uses pay-as-you-go for Warp-provided inference"

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
tooling: the Warp terminal app with the Warp Agent and the Warp Agent CLI; on Free the agent runs on the user's own OpenAI, Anthropic or Google key, or on any OpenAI-compatible custom inference endpoint, and selecting Claude Code or Codex as a cloud harness needs a paid plan; bring-your-own-key and a custom inference endpoint are offered to individual users and organizations of 10 or fewer employees; larger organizations need Business or Enterprise
chaining: the cost moves entirely to the endpoint.

limits.value: the free tier includes no Warp-provided inference at all, so a conversation runs only if a user supplies a key, a subscription or a purchase.

limits_note: the free tier includes no Warp-provided inference at all, so a conversation runs only if a user supplies a key, a subscription or a purchase.

identity_cost.detail: an account is optional for the terminal: the install guide says the sign-up step can be skipped, and a sign-up through Google or GitHub gives Warp only the associated email address; no payment is taken for the Free plan itself. Whether running the Warp Agent with the user's own key needs an account, and whether sign-up asks for a phone number or a card, is not stated
